description: This Java class defines a RESTful API endpoint for managing Employee entities. It handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve employee data by ID, including fallback handlers for invalid path segments, as well as endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting employees. The class uses Spring Framework annotations and components, like @RestController and @RequestMapping, to expose REST API endpoints that interact with the EmployeeService and map Employee domain objects to API resources.

classes.name: EmployeeRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting Employee entities, with specific handling for path placeholders and non-numeric IDs.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Handles GET requests for retrieving an employee by numeric ID, returning 200 OK with the employee resource or 404 if not found.

methods.name: rejectLiteralEmployeeId
methods.description: Handles GET requests with literal placeholder tokens in the URL, returning 400 Bad Request with guidance message.

methods.name: getEmployeeFallback
methods.description: Fallback handler for non-numeric path segments, attempting to parse ID and returning employee data if numeric, otherwise a 404 error.

methods.name: listEmployeesForPreview
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of sample employee previews for testing or monitoring purposes.

methods.name: createEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new Employee based on provided EmployeeResource.

methods.name: updateExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing Employee.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an Employee by ID.

methods.name: safe
methods.description: Utility method for escaping special characters in JSON string fields.
